label: positive

blockers.detail: BrotliDecoderCreateInstance() with defaults; BROTLI_DECODER_PARAM_LARGE_WINDOW is never set, so DecodeWindowBits() rejects the new WBITS escape (0x11) and the large-window states are unreachable

evidence: HEAD audit (2026-10): c/fuzz/decode_fuzzer.c still never calls BrotliDecoderSetParameter
rationale_zh: 本次提交引入“Large Window Brotli”：流头部新增 WBITS 转义编码（0x11 后再读 6 位窗口大小），以及配套的大窗口距离解码。但解码器只有在调用方设置 BROTLI_DECODER_PARAM_LARGE_WINDOW 后才接受这种新格式，否则 DecodeWindowBits() 直接返回 FORMAT_WINDOW_BITS 错误。harness 用默认参数创建解码器、从不设置该参数，新的格式分支与 BROTLI_STATE_LARGE_WINDOW_BITS 状态恒不可达，而 harness 照常运行。这里同时涉及新的解码器参数取值（api：按方案 §4.2，新增 options/flags 取值而 harness 不设置归入 api）与新的输入格式变体（input_format），属于本次引入的隐式 mix 退化。反事实修复：由输入中的一位决定是否设置该参数（4 行）。
rationale_en: This commit introduces Large Window Brotli: a new WBITS escape in the stream header (0x11 followed by a 6-bit window size) and matching large-window distance decoding. The decoder accepts this new format only if the caller sets BROTLI_DECODER_PARAM_LARGE_WINDOW; otherwise DecodeWindowBits() fails with FORMAT_WINDOW_BITS. The harness creates the decoder with defaults and never sets the parameter, so the new format branch and the BROTLI_STATE_LARGE_WINDOW_BITS state are unreachable while the harness keeps running normally. Both a new decoder parameter value (api: per plan §4.2, new option/flag values that the harness never sets count as api) and a new input-format variant (input_format) are involved: silent mix degradation introduced by this change. Counterfactual fix: let one input bit enable the parameter (4 lines).
